A stone-paved sidewalk and a parked scooter are visible in the foreground under bright natural daylight. (3) A pair of hands holds two large paper cups branded with 'Mu Cha Tea' logos. The cup on the left is topped with white foam, while the right cup is filled with a vibrant pink liquid and ice cubes. (4) Montage of close-up shots showing the preparation of a peach drink. The scene then cuts to a medium shot of a female customer in a pink hoodie ordering at the counter from a masked staff member. (8) Final wide shot of the 'Mu Cha Tea' shop exterior in Kaohsiung, showcasing its architectural design and surrounding street environment.
